title: Glass Shelf With Integrated Towel Bar, 16-Inch Triple Tier, Solid Brass Hardware, Wall Mount -, Allied Brass
body_html:
Clear the vanity and keep daily essentials within reach with a wall-mounted glass shelf that adds storage and a dedicated place for towels.

  • More storage in one footprint — triple-tier design creates three levels for toiletries and display.
  • Towels stay ready to grab — integrated towel bar keeps hand towels neatly hung.
  • Built for everyday use — solid brass hardware with 3/8-inch thick tempered, beveled-edge glass.
  • Clean finished installation — concealed screw mounting hardware.
  • Coordinate a traditional look — multiple designer finish options available for classic bath accessories.

  • Weight capacity: 6 lb

  • Assembly required: No
